description: Source code for generating Protocol Buffer definitions from Go types within the Kubernetes code-generator project, including type filtering, naming, and code generation logic.

classes.name: genProtoIDL
classes.description: Main generator struct for producing .proto IDL files from Go types, with configuration options.

classes.name: ProtobufFromGoNamer
classes.description: Interface for converting Go type names to protobuf names.

classes.name: ProtobufLocator
classes.description: Interface for locating protobuf types and related information from Go types.

classes.name: protobufLocator
classes.description: Implementation of ProtobufLocator, handling type conversions and type location logic.

classes.name: bodyGen
classes.description: Helper struct for generating protobuf message definitions from Go types.

classes.name: protoField
classes.description: Represents a protobuf message field with associated metadata.

methods.name: PackageVars
methods.description: Returns package-level options for the protobuf file based on generator settings.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Determines if a given Go type should be included in protobuf generation based on tags and type characteristics.

methods.name: isProtoable
methods.description: Checks recursively if a type can be represented in protobuf.

methods.name: isOptionalAlias
methods.description: Checks if a type is an alias of a map or slice and marked nullable for protobuf.

methods.name: Imports
methods.description: Returns a list of import lines needed for the protobuf file.

methods.name: GenerateType
methods.description: Generates protobuf message definitions for a specific Go type.

methods.name: GoNameToProtoName
methods.description: Converts a Go type name to a protobuf type name.

methods.name: ProtoTypeFor
methods.description: Locates or creates a protobuf type corresponding to a Go type.

methods.name: CastTypeName
methods.description: Returns the cast type name for a Go type, used in protobuf options.

methods.name: membersToFields
methods.description: Converts Go struct members to protobuf message fields.

methods.name: formatProtoFile
methods.description: Placeholder for formatting protobuf source code.

methods.name: assembleProtoFile
methods.description: Assembles and writes the complete protobuf file content.

methods.name: NewProtoFile
methods.description: Creates a new default protobuf file generator configuration.
